title: timeout 4294967297 (wraps to 1 ms) on create and timeout 0 on get still complete

unsafe.definition: an instant error for the tiny timeout that differs in type from the timeout/cancel error

note: WebIDL unsigned long wraps 2^32+1 to 1; L3 §5.1.3/§5.1.4.1: the client corrects an out-of-range timeout to the closest value in its own reasonable range, so it must not expire before the runner approves. Mildly uncertain: depends on the client minimum being >= a few seconds.
